scope: Three individually inspected original source identity/floor/native-name dependencies. No new coordinate authority, manifest reset or requirement promotion.

records.rationale: Data file keys on a layout id; the id (or an alias) must survive or this data silently stops applying.
Production code looks up a layout id at runtime.
Node name is generated from layout data; consumers of the pattern regenerate with the new layout, but the TEMPLATE is a contract for any find_child/save use.

decisions.22c58c6f54f1f44b: Exact original receiving assembler identity. The production adapter requires its entire immutable layout record and validates separately named complete imported owners; preserve this foreign key or explicitly regenerate its owner.
decisions.8ac8488ed5b66c12: Original F01 source roster owns the passage chassis. The adapter validates batch, PASSAGE zone, exterior classification and source-derived hull placement before any retirement.
decisions.4501187225fbb6a2: Native draw names retain a radio_receiving prefix while the radio_receiving_part metadata keeps each exact exported source name. Residency reconstructs the model and imported checks bind every physical draw. Regenerate this naming consumer with its model, never treat it as a room/fixture anchor.
